title: pinus devoniana subsp. procera
intro: Pinus devoniana subsp. procera, commonly known as the tall Scotch pine, is a subspecies of evergreen coniferous tree native to Europe and Western Asia. This tree has been found to have various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its antiseptic and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pinus devoniana subsp. procera include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it effective in treating coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
